set.body:
Plan: docs/plans/2026-09-18-best-recall-to-video-mapper.md docs/plans/2026-09-17-d1a-source-to-story-plan.md §3 S3; mapper plan §3 Phase 2 order.

Film-compiler slices follow the mapper slices (owner-approved sequencing, expressed by priority, not a gate).

Scope:
acquire and its document call sites.

Acceptance criteria:
1. SourceSupport carries (score, support: Option[TypedSupport]) with a text constructor and a derived spans accessor.
2. EvidenceRef gains a support accessor and no new case.
3. hasSpans becomes hasSupport; a court shows every existing text resolver verdict is unchanged.
4. The wire-visible gap reasons (NoSpanEvidence, MissingSpanEvidence) keep their names; their scaladoc is corrected.
5. TaskReferences.validateAgainst gains a NarrativeSourceAtlas overload; no provider module changes.
6. The S0 pins are unchanged; the cold review notes that an acceptance rule changed.

Gate (AGENTS.md SD2/SD6): `sbt -batch clean compileAll testAll` on the merge result, then
`sbt -batch scalafmtCheckAll scalafmtSbtCheck` as a separate run; every test task in build.sbt's
testAll alias reports bound totals (56 at 0e36a7fa, after the corpus modules were added; recount if
modules change); a named mutation witness per new guard, and each compile-time-probe mutation proved
after its own clean recompile; `cd docs-site && npm run verify:examples` when public API or examples
change; fresh-context cold review in a separate pass; the commit body states the evidence and what
it does not establish.

Size: S-M.
set.title: D1A-types S3: acquire carries TypedSupport (film-compiler slice)
